edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged role from caller input.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorize transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner from its parameter.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorize and then promotes it to owner.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender against newOwner.
onlyOwner check on transfernewun compares caller with owner.
transfernewun writes the newun lock address from its parameter.
transfernewun mutates the newun gating state variable.
transfer requires the recipient not to equal the newun lock address.
transfer validates and credits the to parameter.
transfer debits and credits the tokens amount.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
Payable fallback of TokenBEP20 always reverts, blocking plain ETH sends.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by the spender parameter.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for from/msg.sender.
transferFrom reads and debits the from parameter balance.
transferFrom conditionally initialises or checks newun against the to address.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to a payable local and uses onlyOwner for authorization.
clearCNDAO forwards the whole contract balance to the local _owner address.
clearCNDAO executes the native balance transfer instruction.
approveAndCall records allowance for msg.sender before the external call.
The spender parameter is used as the target contract for the receiveApproval callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an attacker-controlled spender contract before returning.
Arbitrary data bytes are forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Execution returns from the external callback into approveAndCall, enabling re-entrant allowance/transfer abuse.
Shoryuken fallback accepts ETH sent by any caller while clearCNDAO drains it.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only feeds the pending owner assignment controlled by transferOwnership.
The parameter only sets the newun lock address inside the owner-only setter.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by the transfer entry point logic.
The amount parameter only feeds the balance arithmetic of the transfer entry point.
The spender parameter is used as the allowance key and callback target of approveAndCall.
The from parameter is the debit source resolved inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for the balanceOf view function.
The data blob is only forwarded through the approveAndCall external call.
The local payable alias exists solely to execute the native balance transfer.
